places.name: Kronenstübli (Grand Hotel Kronenhof)
places.near: Pontresina village centre; 5 min walk from Pontresina station up Via Maistra, or Engadin bus stop Pontresina Post/Kronenhof
places.order: Tasting menu with the fish courses; ask the kitchen for the vegetarian menu (they do it well); Engadin beef dishes are pork-free
places.notes: kronenhof.com Kronenstübli page (season dates, hours, 16 GM)
places.famousFor: 16 GaultMillau points in an Arvenholz-panelled stübli inside the Kronenhof; the top fine-dining table in the valley that is actually open in mid-October
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026: season 19 Jun 2026-3 Apr 2027 (only shuts 1-18 Nov). Dinner 19:00-21:00; closed Sun+Mon outside peak weeks, so aim for Sat 10 Oct. Smart casual, reserve online (aleno) or +41 81 830 30 30. Price CHF 150-250 pp. Kitchen handles no-pork / fish / veg requests on request; small children better at the Grand Restaurant next door.

places.name: Talvo by Dalsass
places.near: Champfèr, between St. Moritz-Bad and Silvaplana; Engadin bus 1/4 to Champfèr Talvo stop; 8 min drive from St. Moritz
places.order: Fish and crustacean courses (Dalsass is famous for them), the vegetable-led dishes with his olive oils; ask for the menu without pork/charcuterie
places.notes: talvo.ch/kontakt (season 12 Jun-18 Oct 2026, days), Michelin Guide
places.famousFor: 1 Michelin star + 18 GaultMillau, Martin Dalsass's signature olive-oil cooking in a 17th-century Engadin farmhouse; the most decorated restaurant open in the autumn
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Sat 10 + Sun 11 Oct 2026 (summer season runs to 18 Oct; Sept-Oct open Thu-Sun only, 12:00-14:30 + from 18:30; CLOSED Mon 12 Oct). Book well ahead +41 81 833 44 55. Price CHF 180-280 pp for menus; lunch a la carte cheaper. Very high-end but relaxed about families at lunch.

places.name: La Trattoria (Hotel Walther)
places.near: Pontresina centre, Via Maistra; 5 min from Pontresina station by bus (stop Pontresina Post)
places.order: Pasta of the day (vegetable or fish fillings), sea bass / branzino, tiramisu; skip guanciale/pancetta pastas (pork)
places.notes: trattoria-walther.ch (2026 schedule: Thu-Mon until 18 Oct), Michelin Guide listing
places.famousFor: Michelin Guide-listed trattoria of the Relais & Chateaux Hotel Walther; fresh stuffed/cut pasta made in-house, playful Italian setting, big favourite with families
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026: until 18 Oct it runs Thu-Mon (closed Tue-Wed); two seatings 18:00 and 20:15 - take the 18:00 with kids. Reserve +41 81 839 36 36. Price CHF 60-90 pp. Same family as Hotel Steinbock and Gondolezza.

places.name: Steinbock Gaststuben - Colani Stübli
places.near: Pontresina centre next to Hotel Walther; bus stop Pontresina Post
places.order: Rösti with mushrooms, Engadin barley soup ONLY if they confirm no bacon (usually contains pork), grilled trout/char, Pizzoccheri (vegetarian), Bündnerfleisch (beef) plate
places.notes: steinbock-gaststuben.ch (hours, address), hotelwalther.ch cuisine page
places.famousFor: Three cosy stübli (Colani hunting lodge, Flora, Farfalla) in the 1830s Hotel Steinbock; the reliable open-7-days Engadin table in Pontresina
places.goodToKnow: OPEN in October (7 days; lunch from 11:30, dinner from 18:00). Online reservation or +41 81 839 36 26. Price CHF 35-60 pp. Ask before ordering Capuns/Salsiz - they contain pork.

places.name: Gondolezza
places.near: In the garden between Hotel Steinbock and Hotel Walther, Via Maistra, Pontresina
places.order: Glacier cheese fondue (ask for it without kirsch/wine if required - they can do a plain version), raclette with potatoes and pickles; skip the charcuterie board (pork)
places.notes: gondolezza.ch (season to 18 Oct, Wed-Sun 17:30)
places.famousFor: Fondue and raclette served inside a decommissioned Diavolezza cable-car cabin fitted with oak tables and fur seats; the kids' favourite dinner in the Engadin
places.goodToKnow: OPEN until 18 Oct 2026, Wed-Sun from 17:30 (closed Mon+Tue - so Sat 10/Sun 11 Oct only; Mon 12 closed). Tiny (a few tables) - book online (aleno) or +41 81 839 36 26 as soon as dates are fixed. Price CHF 35-50 pp. Cash-friendly, casual.

places.name: Pitschna Scena (Hotel Saratz)
places.near: Right by Pontresina station (Via da la Staziun); Engadin bus stop Pontresina Bahnhof
places.order: Homemade pasta, risotto, lake fish, Engadin beef tagliata; vegetarian mains always on the menu
places.notes: saratz.ch restaurants page (hours, chef); autumn closing date not published
places.famousFor: Lively bistro of the Saratz (Swiss Family Hotel) with chef Giuseppe Marrancone (ex-14 GM); great for a relaxed family dinner with a bar buzz
places.goodToKnow: Daily 12:00-23:00 (hot food 12-14 / 18-21:30) during the hotel season; Saratz's summer season normally runs to mid/late October - CONFIRM 10-12 Oct 2026 by phone +41 81 839 40 00 before relying on it. Price CHF 40-70 pp. Kids' menu, playroom in hotel.

places.name: Hotel Restaurant Morteratsch
places.near: Bernina train from Pontresina 10 min to Morteratsch station (restaurant adjoins it); by car 8 min from Pontresina on the Bernina road, free parking
places.order: Rösti, Pizzoccheri (vegetarian), raclette, home-baked cakes; Capuns here usually contain Salsiz (pork) - ask
places.notes: morteratsch.ch restaurant page (season, hours, address)
places.famousFor: Historic 1875 glacier inn with its own Bernina-line station at the start of the Morteratsch glacier trail; 400 seats, big terrace, famous home-baked cakes and a self-service fondue/raclette
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026 (summer season 4 Jun-25 Oct; daily 08:00-21:30, hot kitchen 11:30-16:00 + 18:00-20:30). Walk-ins fine for lunch, book dinner +41 81 842 63 13. Price CHF 25-45 pp. Ideal lunch after the 1h glacier walk with the children.

places.name: Hotel Restaurant Roseg Gletscher
places.near: Horse carriage from Pontresina station (book roseg-gletscher.ch/carriage, ~45 min) or 1.5 h flat walk / bike up Val Roseg; no cars
places.order: Dessert buffet (the reason to come), Rösti, trout, barley soup only if confirmed without bacon
places.notes: roseg-gletscher.ch (2026 season 12.06-18.10), myswitzerland listing
places.famousFor: Car-free glacier-valley inn reached by horse-drawn carriage from Pontresina; legendary dessert buffet and the Roseg glacier panorama
places.goodToKnow: OPEN until 18 Oct 2026 (summer season 12 Jun-18 Oct, carriages run the same dates). Self-service + table-service rooms; reserve the carriage days ahead, table +41 81 842 64 45. Price CHF 30-55 pp. Golden larches in Val Roseg peak exactly mid-October.

places.name: Berghaus Diavolezza
places.near: Diavolezza cable car from Bernina Diavolezza station (Bernina train from Pontresina 15 min, or car/free parking on the Bernina road); car runs 07:40-16:20 every 20 min
places.order: Diavolezza spaghetti (diced beef, tomato, cream - note it is finished with brandy; ask for it without), Rösti, cheese fondue, soup of the day
places.notes: corvatsch-diavolezza.ch operating hours page (summer to 16.10.2026, autumn 17.10-15.11 Wed/Sat/Sun)
places.famousFor: The highest hotel-restaurant in the Engadin facing Piz Palü and Piz Bernina glaciers; signature 'Diavolezza spaghetti' and a big sun terrace
places.goodToKnow: OPEN daily Oct 10-12 2026 (summer cable-car season 4 May-16 Oct daily; from 17 Oct only Wed/Sat/Sun). Reserve +41 81 839 39 00 for a window table. Price CHF 25-45 pp plus cable car (~CHF 40 adult). Dress warm - near 3,000 m; the glacier viewpoint is 2 min from the terrace.

places.name: Albergo Ristorante Alp Grüm
places.near: Bernina train only: St. Moritz-Alp Grüm ~1 h, Pontresina ~45 min; no road access. Combine with Ospizio Bernina and Diavolezza on one Bernina day
places.order: Pizzoccheri (buckwheat pasta, cabbage, potatoes, cheese - vegetarian), polenta with mushrooms or cheese, torta di grano saraceno; check the Valposchiavo salami/pork platters and skip them
places.notes: alpgruem.ch (hours), pontresina.ch listing (season 9 May-8 Nov 2026)
places.famousFor: Station restaurant at the most photographed stop of the Bernina Express with the Palü glacier and Lago Palü below; Pizzoccheri and polenta country begins here
places.goodToKnow: OPEN daily 9 May-8 Nov 2026, 08:00-18:00 (hot meals 11:00-18:00). Reserve for groups of 7: +41 81 844 03 18. Price CHF 20-40 pp. Sits right on the platform - check the train timetable so the family is not stranded between hourly trains.

places.name: Buffet Ospizio Bernina
places.near: Bernina train stop Ospizio Bernina (30 min from Pontresina) or car on the Bernina pass road, parking at the station
places.order: Pizzoccheri, minestrone, polenta, apple strudel; avoid the salami boards
places.notes: ospiziobernina.ch (hours), booking.com listing (closed 3 Nov-5 Dec)
places.famousFor: Old station buffet on the highest point of the Bernina railway at Lago Bianco; same Da Primo family as Alp Grüm; hearty pass food with glacier views
places.goodToKnow: OPEN in October (only closes 3 Nov-5 Dec); daily 08:30-17:30, hot meals 11:00-17:30. Reservations +41 81 844 03 18. Price CHF 20-40 pp. Simple and honest; a 10-minute train hop from Alp Grüm.

places.name: Restaurant Sportpavillon
places.near: Via Maistra at the sports pavilion, lower Pontresina; bus stop Pontresina Rondo
places.order: Margherita / vegetable / tuna pizzas (skip prosciutto & salami), Engadin beef entrecote, kids' pasta
places.notes: search.ch / Tripadvisor listing (address, steakhouse-pizzeria)
places.famousFor: Pontresina's casual family stop by the ice rink/sports centre with a mountain-facing terrace; wood-fired pizzas and Engadin beef steaks
places.goodToKnow: Open year-round (call +41 81 842 63 46 to confirm mid-October days). Price CHF 20-40 pp. Good back-up when the fancier places are closed Mon/Tue.

places.name: Panorama Restaurant Muottas Muragl
places.near: Funicular from Punt Muragl (between Samedan and Pontresina; bus stop Punt Muragl Talstation, free parking); runs 07:45-23:00 every 30 min
places.order: Lake char or trout, Engadin beef, vegetarian tasting dishes, Engadin nut cake; for a cheap family lunch use the Scatla self-service next door
places.notes: muottasmuragl.ch operating hours (season 6 Jun-25 Oct 2026, funicular times)
places.famousFor: The best-view restaurant in the Engadin - the whole lake chain from a funicular-only Romantik Hotel; famous sunset dinner spot
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026: summer season 6 Jun-25 Oct, hotel + panorama restaurant daily 08:00-23:00 (Scatla 08:00-17:00). After 25 Oct only the terrace/Scatla runs to 1 Nov. Book a window table for sunset +41 81 842 82 32. Price CHF 40-80 pp plus funicular. Top 'wow' dinner for the kids. · Location needs verification

places.name: Restaurant Marguns - Chadafö
places.near: Celerina-Marguns gondola (valley station 5 min from Celerina station; car park at the lift); 12 min ride
places.order: Pizzas (Margherita, funghi, tonno), homemade tagliatelle, Rösti; avoid speck/salami toppings
places.notes: mountains.ch Marguns page (27 Jun-18 Oct 2026 daily 8-17, address)
places.famousFor: Corviglia's family mountain restaurant at the top of the Celerina gondola; wood-oven pizzas, pasta and a giant sun terrace, hiking trails to Corviglia
places.goodToKnow: OPEN daily 08:00-17:00 until 18 Oct 2026 (gondola same dates); Free-Flow self-service is shut in summer, Chadafö table-service runs. No reservation needed for lunch; +41 81 839 80 20. Price CHF 20-40 pp plus lift. NOTE: the St. Moritz-Chantarella-Corviglia funicular is out of service for rebuilding in 2026, so Marguns is the way up Corviglia. · Location needs verification

places.name: Restaurant Lej da Staz
places.area: Lej da Staz (Celerina / St. Moritz forest)
places.near: 20-25 min flat forest walk from St. Moritz-Bad or Celerina station (no public road access for cars); horse carriage from St. Moritz possible
places.order: Lake fish, Rösti variations, vegetarian Capuns if offered (ask - classic Capuns contain Salsiz), Engadin nut cake
places.notes: laudinella.ch Lej da Staz page (season 4 Jun-19 Oct 2026, hours, address)
places.famousFor: Lakeside inn on the little forest lake Lej da Staz in the Staz woods between St. Moritz and Celerina; larch-forest terrace, the classic autumn walk-and-lunch
places.goodToKnow: OPEN until 19 Oct 2026 (summer 4 Jun-19 Oct, daily 11:30-17:00 - lunch only). Closed 20 Oct-3 Dec. Book +41 81 833 60 50 for a group of 7. Price CHF 30-55 pp. Golden larches around the lake peak 10-15 Oct.

places.name: Restorant Uondas (Hotel Chesa Rosatsch)
places.near: Celerina old village by the Inn; 5 min walk from Celerina station, bus stop Celerina Cresta Palace
places.order: Dry-aged Engadin beef cuts, Lostallo salmon, goat-cheese Flammkuchen (ask for it without bacon), Piculezzas sharing starters
places.notes: rosatsch.ch Uondas page (address, hours, Hatecke beef), Michelin Guide Stüvas Rosatsch listing
places.famousFor: The Engadin's meat restaurant: house-aged Hatecke Engadin beef (4-12 weeks in the on-site chamber) grilled on lava stone, Misox salmon, Flammkuchen; sister of 15-GM Stüvas Rosatsch
places.goodToKnow: Open year-round with the hotel: daily 12:00-17:00 + 18:00-20:30 (confirm October days +41 81 837 01 01). Online booking. Price CHF 60-110 pp. Beef only - no pork on the grill, but ask about marinades; excellent for the meat-loving teenagers.

places.name: La Padella (Hotel Donatz)
places.near: Samedan village square (Plazzet), 5 min walk from Samedan station; Engadin bus stop Samedan Plazzet
places.order: Beef fillet 'Woranoff' flambéed at the table (mustard sauce - contains vodka, ask for it without), lake fish, Rösti, crepes Suzette for the kids
places.notes: myswitzerland Hotel Donatz La Padella listing (open to 08.11.2026, Tue-Sat), Michelin Guide
places.famousFor: Michelin Guide-listed old-school dining room in Samedan's Hotel Donatz: dishes flambéed at the table, 550-label wine cellar, family-run since generations
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026 (runs until 8 Nov; Tue-Sat 17:45-23:00 - so Sat 10 Oct only in your window; closed Sun/Mon). Reserve +41 81 852 46 66. Price CHF 70-120 pp. Quiet, smart; better for the older kids.

places.name: Hatecke
places.near: Via Maistra in St. Moritz Dorf centre, 2 min from the Schulhausplatz bus hub; funicular/train to St. Moritz then bus 1 to Schulhausplatz
places.order: Bündnerfleisch (100% beef - halal-friendly by ingredient, not certified), beef tartare, braised beef cheeks, boiled beef Siedfleisch; AVOID Salsiz (pork/beef mix) and Speck
places.notes: Michelin Guide Hatecke page (address, hours, no bookings)
places.famousFor: Michelin Guide-listed minimalist bistro of the Hatecke butchery - Switzerland's most famous Bündnerfleisch (air-dried beef) maker; tartare, carpaccio, Siedfleisch, Big Green Egg grill on the terrace
places.goodToKnow: Year-round; Mon-Tue 09:00-19:00, Wed 09:00-20:30, Thu-Fri 09:00-22:00, Sat 10:00-18:00, CLOSED Sunday (so Sat 10 + Mon 12 Oct). No reservations - go for a late lunch. Price CHF 35-70 pp. Buy vacuum-packed Bündnerfleisch as gifts next door.

places.name: Restaurant Engiadina am Innfall
places.near: Via Dimlej at the lake outflow, 5 min walk from St. Moritz station along the lake; bus stop St. Moritz Bahnhof
places.order: Cheese fondue (ask for kirsch-free), fondue chinoise with beef, grilled trout, Rösti, meringue with cream
places.notes: restaurant-engiadina.ch + stmoritz.com listing (address, daily hours)
places.famousFor: St. Moritz's classic fondue house by the Inn waterfall at the lake end; big menu of Swiss meat, grill and cheese fondues, locals' choice for a non-hotel dinner
places.goodToKnow: Open daily 11:30-22:00 year-round (confirm October +41 81 833 30 00). Reserve for 7. Price CHF 35-65 pp. Fondue chinoise broth is beef - a good pork-free sharing dinner for the whole family.

places.name: Hauser Restaurant
places.near: Via Traunter Plazzas, the pedestrian square in the centre of St. Moritz Dorf, 1 min from Schulhausplatz bus stop
places.order: Beef or fish on the hot stone (you cook it yourself - kids love it), Rösti, vegetarian pasta, the nut cake and Hauser's hot chocolate
places.notes: hotelhauser.ch + pontresina.ch listing (hours to 20.10.2026, address)
places.famousFor: The Hauser family's all-day Dorf institution with the famous 'Pioda' hot-stone grill, huge terrace on the pedestrian square and the Hauser Confiserie (Engadin nut cake, hot chocolate)
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026 (season runs to 20 Oct 2026, then reopens 28 Nov); daily 07:00-21:00. Reservations +41 81 837 50 50. Price CHF 30-60 pp. Breakfast/brunch also good; no-pork hot stone = choose beef/fish.

places.name: Pizzeria Caruso (Hotel Laudinella)
places.near: Hotel Laudinella in St. Moritz-Bad; bus 1/2 stop Laudinella (5 min from Dorf), 10 min walk from St. Moritz Bad centre
places.order: Margherita, Quattro Formaggi, tonno e cipolla, verdure pizzas; pasta al pomodoro for the 4-year-old; skip prosciutto/salame/speck pizzas
places.notes: laudinella.ch restaurants + Tripadvisor/OpenTable listing (year-round, address, hours)
places.famousFor: The pizza institution of St. Moritz - thin Neapolitan pizzas from the wood oven, lively and open all year in the Laudinella (Lonely Planet pick)
places.goodToKnow: OPEN all year (Zwischensaison included) - daily 17:30-23:00. Reserve +41 81 836 06 50 or OpenTable; large tables OK. Price CHF 25-40 pp. Laudinella's sister outlets Stüva (Swiss), Made in Asia and Corvatsch are in the same building.

places.name: La Stalla Ristorante & Pizzeria
places.near: Plazza dal Mulin in St. Moritz Dorf, 3 min walk from Schulhausplatz
places.order: Wood-fired pizzas (veg/tuna/cheese), cheese fondue, Rösti with fried egg, entrecote; ask about Capuns (usually pork)
places.notes: Tripadvisor / Yelp listing (address, phone, Google rating)
places.famousFor: Cosy chalet-style upstairs room in the Dorf doing both wood-fired pizza and Swiss classics - the easiest 'everyone finds something' family table
places.goodToKnow: Open year-round (confirm Oct days +41 81 837 58 59); reservations recommended, waits can be long. Google 4.2. Price CHF 25-50 pp. Reviews are mixed on pizza vs. fondue - order the Swiss dishes.

places.name: Chesa Veglia (Badrutt's Palace) - CLOSED mid-Oct
places.near: Via Veglia opposite the Palace, St. Moritz Dorf
places.order: (Winter/summer only) Pizza at Heuboden, Chateaubriand at Chadafö
places.notes: badruttspalace.com winter/summer gastronomy pages; kulm.com Chesa al Parc (summer to 30 Aug 2026)
places.famousFor: 1658 farmhouse of Badrutt's Palace with Grill Chadafö, Patrizier Stuben and the family Pizzeria Heuboden - the most famous address in St. Moritz
places.goodToKnow: CLOSED 10-12 Oct 2026: Badrutt's Palace and Chesa Veglia shut after the summer season (early Sept) and reopen for winter in December. Listed so it is not planned for; same applies to Kulm's Chesa al Parc (summer ended 30 Aug 2026), Carlton, Suvretta House.

places.name: Ecco St. Moritz (Giardino Mountain) - WINTER ONLY
places.near: Giardino Mountain hotel, Champfèr
places.order: (Winter only) tasting menu
places.notes: Michelin Guide St. Moritz list; Giardino/Carlton seasonal pages
places.famousFor: Rolf Fliegauf's 2-Michelin-star pop-up in Giardino Mountain, the highest-rated table in the Engadin
places.goodToKnow: NOT AVAILABLE Oct 2026 - Ecco operates only in the winter season (Dec-Mar). Likewise Da Vittorio St. Moritz (2*, Carlton Hotel, Via Johannes Badrutt 11) is winter-only. Both flagged so the itinerary does not count on them. · Location needs verification

places.name: Restaurant 3303 (Corvatsch)
places.near: Corvatsch cable car from Surlej (Silvaplana), two sections via Murtèl; valley station beside Nira Alpina, bus stop Surlej Corvatschbahn, big car park
places.order: Rösti, pasta, soup of the day, Engadin beef plate; simple menu - the view is the dish
places.notes: corvatsch-diavolezza.ch Restaurant 3303 page (dates, hours, address)
places.famousFor: Highest restaurant in Graubünden at the Corvatsch top station with a 360-degree view over the Bernina glaciers and the whole lake plateau
places.goodToKnow: OPEN daily Oct 10-12 2026 (summer season 20 Jun-16 Oct, 08:30-17:00, hot meals 11:00-15:30). Autumn 17 Oct-20 Nov closed Mon-Sat. Reserve +41 81 838 73 60. Price CHF 25-45 pp plus lift (~CHF 60 adult return). Altitude: keep the 4-year-old hydrated, short visit.

places.name: Stars Restaurant (Nira Alpina)
places.near: Nira Alpina at the Corvatsch valley station, Surlej; bus stop Surlej Corvatschbahn, 10 min drive from St. Moritz
places.order: Thai curries with fish/chicken, Indian vegetarian dishes, Japanese-style fish, Engadin lamb
places.notes: niraalpina.com (summer to 11 Oct 2026, winter from 4 Dec), silvaplana.ch restaurant directory
places.famousFor: Top-floor restaurant of the design hotel connected to the Corvatsch cable car; panoramic lake view and a menu built for international guests - the most Gulf-friendly menu in the valley
places.goodToKnow: TIGHT: Nira Alpina's summer season ends 11 Oct 2026 (winter reopens 4 Dec) - dinner possible Sat 10 or Sun 11 Oct only; confirm +41 81 838 69 69. Price CHF 60-100 pp. Rooftop terrace closes early when cold.

places.name: Restaurant Bellavista
places.near: Via da l'Alp in Surlej, 3 min walk from the Corvatsch valley station; bus stop Surlej Corvatschbahn
places.order: Venison/chamois game dishes in October (game season), house-dried Bündnerfleisch (beef), trout, Rösti; skip Salsiz
places.notes: engadin.ch / pontresina.ch Bellavista listing (season 05.06-18.10.2026, hours, address)
places.famousFor: Family hotel-restaurant at the foot of Corvatsch with its own meat-drying room, own hunting grounds (autumn game season) and a hunting-lodge room with open-fire cooking
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026 (summer 5 Jun-18 Oct, daily 07:30-22:00). Reserve +41 81 838 60 50. Price CHF 40-80 pp. Ask whether the game is prepared in wine/cream sauces; plain grilled cuts available.

places.name: Murtaröl - The Fish Restaurant (Plaun da Lej)
places.near: On the lakeshore road between Sils and Maloja (Plaun da Lej); Engadin bus 4 stop Plaun da Lej; 20 min drive from St. Moritz, parking on site
places.order: Grilled whole sea bass/branzino, seafood platter, spaghetti alle vongole, lake trout, grilled scampi; ask for dishes without wine reduction
places.notes: murtarol.ch / plaundalej.ch + GaultMillau Murtaröl listing (365 days, address)
places.famousFor: GaultMillau-listed fish house on Lake Sils - fish and shellfish bought daily at Milan's market, plus local trout; the best fish table in the Alps and open 365 days
places.goodToKnow: OPEN 365 days, kitchen non-stop 11:45-22:45 - the safest premium booking for the Zwischensaison. Reserve +41 81 826 53 50 (sheltered lake terrace). Price CHF 60-120 pp (fish by weight). Perfect fit for a no-pork family.
places.address: Via dal Malögia 14, 7517 Plaun da Lej (Sils)

places.name: Arvenstube (Hotel Waldhaus Sils)
places.near: Above Sils Maria village (Via da Fex); bus 4 to Sils Maria Post then 5 min uphill, or hotel bus; 20 min drive from St. Moritz
places.order: Lake char, veal or beef classics, vegetarian menu on request, the dessert trolley
places.notes: waldhaus-sils.ch (address, phone) + Waldhaus newsletter 'Sommersaison bis 25. Oktober'
places.famousFor: Stone-pine dining room of the legendary 1908 Waldhaus (Nietzsche's Sils, family-run 5 generations); live evening music in the hall, timeless grand-hotel atmosphere
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026 (summer season runs to 25 Oct 2026). Non-residents welcome with reservation +41 81 838 51 00; jacket-and-tie tradition relaxed to smart. Price CHF 80-130 pp. Children welcome (own kids' programme).
places.address: Via da Fex 3, 7514 Sils im Engadin

places.name: Hotel Fex (Val Fex)
places.near: Horse carriage from Sils Maria (Fex-Kutschen, ~40 min) or 1.5 h walk; hotel minibus for dinner guests from Sils Maria 17:15/18:45/19:45, return 18:30/19:30/21:30
places.order: Fex trout, Rösti, vegetarian Capuns/Pizzoccheri (ask), local cheese plates, apple strudel
places.notes: hotelfex.ch/en (hours, minibus, address; season pattern)
places.famousFor: Swiss Historic Hotel at the end of the car-free Fex valley; reached by horse carriage from Sils - larch forests, glacier view, regional kitchen with good vegetarian/vegan options
places.goodToKnow: Summer season normally runs to about 18-19 Oct (site shows 20 Jun-19 Oct pattern) - CONFIRM 2026 dates +41 81 832 60 00. Lunch 11:30-15:00, dinner 18:00-21:00. Price CHF 35-65 pp. Book the carriage separately. · Location needs verification

places.name: Hotel Sonne Fex
places.near: Horse carriage or 1 h walk from Sils Maria (car-free valley); own guests' shuttle
places.order: Rösti, trout, barley soup only if confirmed without bacon, Engadin nut cake
places.notes: hotel-sonne-fex.ch (season 5 Jun-25 Oct 2026, map coordinates shown on site)
places.famousFor: Sunny-terrace inn in Fex-Platta, the classic carriage-ride lunch stop in the protected Fex valley with glacier and larch views
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026 (season 5 Jun-25 Oct 2026). Call +41 81 826 53 73 for lunch reservation. Price CHF 25-45 pp. Simpler than Hotel Fex, larger terrace.

places.name: Hotel Schweizerhaus Maloja (Orsini / Engadiner Stübli / Kutscherbar)
places.near: Main road in Maloja village, bus 4 stop Maloja Schweizerhaus; 30 min drive from St. Moritz; parking
places.order: Orsini tasting with fish; Stübli: Rösti, Pizzoccheri, trout; Kutscherbar: pizzas for the kids
places.notes: schweizerhaus.swiss restaurants page (address, outlets) + season 12 Jun-18 Oct 2026
places.famousFor: Maloja's landmark hotel at the top of the pass with three outlets: modern gourmet Orsini, the unchanged 100-year-old Engadiner Stübli and a pizza/regional Kutscherbar; 300-label cellar
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026 (summer season 12 Jun-18 Oct 2026, restaurants daily). Reserve +41 81 838 28 28. Price CHF 30-50 (Stübli/pizza) to CHF 90-140 (Orsini). Good lunch base for the Maloja/Segantini excursion.

places.name: Chesa Stüva Colani
places.near: Madulain village, 3 min walk from Madulain station (Engadin line St. Moritz-Scuol, 25 min); 20 min drive from St. Moritz

Price CHF 150-220 pp (Michelin: EUR-EUR-EUR-EUR); bistro CHF 40-70. Strongest vegetarian fine dining in the region.

places.name: Krone La Punt - La Chavallera & Fö e Flamma

places.near: Village square of La Punt at the Albula pass turn-off, 5 min from La Punt-Chamues-ch station; 20 min drive from St. Moritz
places.order: Chavallera: sea bass in brown butter, sturgeon with caviar, quail; Fö e Flamma: reinterpreted alpine dishes, sourdough bakery, kids' portions
places.notes: krone-lapunt.ch cuisine page (2026 dates, hours, star), GaultMillau Krone Säumerei am Inn

places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026 (summer 12 Jun-18 Oct). La Chavallera Tue-Sat 18:00-21:00 (so Sat 10 Oct); Fö e Flamma Thu-Mon 07:30-21:00 (Sat/Sun/Mon all fit). Reserve +41 81 854 12 69. Price CHF 160-250 (4/6/9-course) / CHF 30-60 casual. Menus are fish-, game- and vegetable-led; say no-pork at booking.

places.name: Restorant Dorta
places.near: Zuoz village, 5 min walk from Zuoz station (Engadin line), bus stop Zuoz Dorta
places.order: Spinach gnocchi with melted cheese, hay soup, carrot-ginger soup, Pizzoccheri, trout; the Spätzle come with roasted bacon - ask for them plain
places.notes: engadin.ch Dorta page + Yelp (address, hours, dishes)

places.goodToKnow: Open Wed-Sun 10:00-23:00 (hot food 12:00-22:00), Tue from 18:00, Mon closed - Sat 10 + Sun 11 Oct fit. Reserve +41 81 854 20 40. Price CHF 35-60 pp. Zuoz is the prettiest Engadin village - combine with a walk.

places.name: Hotel Veduta (Cinuos-chel)
places.near: On the main road at Cinuos-chel-Brail station (Engadin line, 35 min from St. Moritz); parking
places.order: Pizzoccheri, game ragout (venison) in autumn, trout, hay-soup; Capuns and barley soup here contain Salsiz/bacon - ask
places.notes: veduta.ch gastronomy page (hours, dishes, address), Lunchgate (Nov/Apr closures)
places.famousFor: Roadside inn between S-chanf and Zernez at the National Park gateway; homemade Capuns, barley soup, Pizzoccheri and game from the family's own hunt; open all day
places.goodToKnow: Open daily from 08:00, hot meals 11:30-21:00, small menu 13:45-18:00; closes only in November and April - OPEN in October. +41 81 854 12 53. Price CHF 25-45 pp. Handy lunch on the way to Zernez / National Park.

places.name: Historic Hotel Chesa Salis - VERIFY (may be closed)
places.near: Bever village, 5 min walk from Bever station; 10 min drive from Samedan
places.order: Seasonal menu, fish and vegetable courses
places.notes: myswitzerland listing (GESCHLOSSEN flag), GaultMillau Chesa Salis page, Yelp

places.name: L'Usteria (Hotel Bär & Post)
places.near: Zernez centre, 3 min walk from Zernez station (Engadin line, 50 min from St. Moritz); parking
places.order: Trout, Schlutzkrapfen (spinach-ricotta ravioli), Pizzoccheri, Rösti; ask about speck in dumplings
places.notes: baer-post.ch restaurant page + engadin.com listing (address, cuisine)
places.famousFor: Family-run 1905 hotel at the Swiss National Park gateway; Engadin-South Tyrol kitchen, big sun terrace, kids' meals - the Zernez lunch stop before/after the park visitor centre
places.goodToKnow: Open year-round (confirm October hours +41 81 851 55 00). Price CHF 25-50 pp. National Park Centre is 5 min away; Il Fuorn park road restaurants close mid/late Oct.

places.name: GuardaVal Gourmet (Belvedere Hotel Family)
places.near: Stradun (main street) Scuol, 10 min walk from Scuol-Tarasp station (Engadin line terminus, 1 h 15 from St. Moritz); Belvedere bus stop
places.order: 'Paschiun Pitschna' 3-course (CHF 75), lake/river fish, vegetable-led courses; Tavolata alpina for the family
places.notes: belvedere-hotelfamilie.ch GuardaVal Gourmet page (address, hours, 14 GM, CHF 75 menu)
places.famousFor: Scuol's top table - 14-15 GaultMillau, chef René Stoye's reduced-to-the-region cooking in the boutique GuardaVal; award-winning wine list, panorama terrace
places.goodToKnow: Open Tue-Sat from 18:30 (Sun/Mon closed outside high season) - Sat 10 Oct; the Belvedere family hotels run year-round. Reserve +41 81 861 09 09. Price CHF 75-130 pp. Sister outlets Allegra/Belvair/Nam Thai (Thai) in Hotel Belvedere for the kids.

places.name: Hotel Engiadina Scuol (Stüvetta / Cuort / Ustaria)
places.near: Rablüzza in Scuol old village (Sot), 10 min walk from Scuol-Tarasp station; near the Bogn Engiadina thermal baths
places.order: Trout, Rösti, Pizzoccheri, Engadin nut cake at 15:00-17:00 cake time; check Capuns/barley soup for pork
places.notes: myswitzerland Hotel Engiadina Restaurant listing (address, rooms, coordinates)
places.famousFor: The oldest inn in Scuol with three atmospheric rooms (romantic Stüvetta, courtyard Cuort, cosy Ustaria), own wine cellar and afternoon cakes
places.goodToKnow: Year-round village inn; reserve +41 81 864 14 21. Price CHF 30-55 pp. Pair with Bogn Engiadina baths (kids) and Tarasp castle.

places.name: Bocca Fina & Ustaria (Schlosshotel Chastè Tarasp)
places.near: Sparsels hamlet below Tarasp Castle; PostBus from Scuol-Tarasp station 15 min, or 10 min drive from Scuol
places.order: Bocca Fina fish and vegetable courses; Ustaria: trout, Pizzoccheri, seasonal game
places.notes: schlosshoteltarasp.ch cuisine page (16 GM, address), GaultMillau Chastè listing
places.famousFor: Relais & Chateaux castle-village hotel under Tarasp Castle; Bocca Fina menu with 16 GaultMillau points (chef Andreas Heidenreich, 15 pts), casual Ustaria for lunch
places.goodToKnow: Autumn season dates not published online - Chastè normally runs through late October but CONFIRM +41 81 861 30 60. Price CHF 90-150 gourmet / CHF 35-60 Ustaria. Castle tour + lunch makes a full Lower-Engadin day.

places.name: Hotel Meisser (Guarda)
places.near: Guarda village (car-free centre), PostBus from Guarda station up the hill; 25 min drive from Scuol
places.order: 4-course seasonal dinner (vegetarian option always), lunch trout or Rösti, mountain-herb dishes
places.notes: hotel-meisser.ch restaurant page (season 8 May-8 Nov 2026, address)
places.famousFor: Swiss Historic Hotel in Guarda, the Schellen-Ursli village of painted sgraffito houses; art-nouveau hall dinners and a panoramic lunch restaurant, herbs and flowers from the village
places.goodToKnow: OPEN Oct 10-12 2026 (summer season 8 May-8 Nov 2026). External guests by reservation +41 81 862 21 32. Price CHF 40-90 pp. Guarda is worth the detour for the kids (Schellen-Ursli story).

places.name: Grand Restaurant breakfast – Grand Hotel Kronenhof
places.near: Via Maistra 130, upper Pontresina; bus 'Pontresina Post/Kronenhof'; hotel parking
places.order: Full buffet: Engadin breads, mountain cheeses, eggs cooked to order, fresh juices; ask for the Nusstorte slice
places.notes: Source: kronenhof.com Grand Restaurant page (hours, dress code) + bar-lobby page (season)
places.famousFor: Breakfast under the frescoed baroque ceiling of the 1848 Kronenhof Grand Restaurant – the most beautiful breakfast room in the Engadin
places.goodToKnow: Breakfast daily 07:00–11:00; hotel open continuously 12 Jun 2026–4 Apr 2027 so OPEN 10–12 Oct incl. Sunday. Non-guest breakfast on reservation only – price not published, call +41 81 830 30 30 (expect CHF 50–60 range typical of 5* Engadin hotels; confirm). Dress code: elegant, jacket required for men. Vegetarian menus on request; no dogs.

places.name: Grand Restaurant breakfast – Hotel Walther (Relais & Châteaux)
places.near: Via Maistra 215, centre of Pontresina; bus 'Pontresina Rondo'
places.order: Buffet with regional cheeses, house pastries, egg station; lounge menu later in the day 12:00–22:00
places.notes: Source: hotelwalther.ch (season dates) + grandrestaurant.ch + engadin.ch listing (coords)
places.famousFor: Rich breakfast buffet in the Belle-Époque Jugendstil hall of the Walther, next door to the Steinbock; one of the few Pontresina grand hotels that stays open through the whole autumn
places.goodToKnow: Hotel open 12 Jun–30 Nov 2026 (late-autumn wellness programme 18 Oct–10 Dec) – OPEN 10–12 Oct incl. Sunday. Breakfast buffet is described for hotel guests; outsiders should phone +41 81 839 36 36 the day before – no external price published. Lounge menu daily 12:00–22:00 is open to all.

places.name: Hotel Steinbock breakfast buffet
places.near: Via Maistra 219, centre of Pontresina beside the Walther; bus 'Pontresina Rondo'
places.order: Buffet 07:30–10:00: Bündner Fleisch, Alpkäse, Birnenbrot, Zopf, Bircher müesli
places.notes: Source: hotelsteinbock.ch (closure dates) + booking/holidaycheck listings (buffet hours) + pontresina.ch (coords)
places.famousFor: Breakfast in the wood-panelled Gaststuben of a 1651 Engadin house – the cosy, family-priced alternative to the Kronenhof/Walther
places.goodToKnow: SEASON FLAG: open until 18 Oct 2026, then CLOSED 18 Oct–10 Dec – so still open 10–12 Oct incl. Sunday. Breakfast buffet daily 07:30–10:00; external guests pay on site (price not published – call +41 81 839 36 26). Half-board reference CHF 45 pp. Family-run, kids welcome.

places.name: Restaurant Hauser – breakfast & Sunday Zopf
places.near: Via Traunter Plazzas 7, central square by the Schulhausplatz bus hub; short walk from the Chantarella funicular
places.order: Hauser granola with yoghurt, eggs of your choice, Sunday Zopf with butter and jam, 'Coffee Gipfeli' for a quick start
places.notes: Source: hotelhauser.ch restaurant page + brunchselection.ch voucher listing (CHF 25 reference) + engadin.ch listing (coords, season)
places.famousFor: The village-centre breakfast address since 1892: home-baked goods from the Hauser Backstube, regional dairy and cold cuts, egg dishes, and fresh Zopf every Sunday, served on the biggest sun terrace in St. Moritz
places.goodToKnow: Restaurant daily from 07:00 (listing valid to 20 Oct 2026) – OPEN Sun 11 Oct with Zopf. À-la-carte breakfast & brunch (gift-voucher reference CHF 25 pp); no fixed buffet price published. Halal note: pork cold cuts on the board – order egg/dairy/bakery items. Terrace, takeaway, family-friendly, no reservation needed except large groups (+41 81 837 50 50).

places.name: Laagers Restaurant-Café & Bakery
places.near: Plazzet 22, main square of Samedan old town; 6 min walk from Samedan station
places.order: Butter Gipfeli, Birnenbrot, Bircher müesli, fresh juice; Nusstorte to go
places.notes: Source: laagers.ch restaurant-café page (hours) + local.ch/search.ch listings
places.famousFor: Samedan's bakery-hotel on the Plazzet square: breakfast pastries straight from their own Backstube, continental or buffet, from 07:15
places.goodToKnow: Café Mon–Fri 07:15–19:30, Sat–Sun 07:15–19:00 – OPEN Sun 11 Oct; year-round, no Zwischensaison closure listed for Samedan. Lunch menus 11:00–15:00. Breakfast prices for walk-ins not published (+41 81 852 52 35). Terrace; vegetarian-friendly bakery fare.

places.name: Café & Restaurant BUN DI
places.near: Via da Mulin 28, central Pontresina near the Rondo; parking on site
places.order: Müesli bowl, fresh Zopf/bread basket with jams, cappuccino; vegan bowl options
places.notes: Source: pontresina.ch guide listing (hours, coords, offerings)
places.famousFor: Newly redesigned all-day café with a big sun terrace: fresh breads and patisserie from 07:30, müesli and bowls, later pizza/pasta – the easy family breakfast in Pontresina, open year-round
places.goodToKnow: Daily 07:30–23:00 (1 May 2026–30 Apr 2027) – OPEN Sun 11 Oct and through the Zwischensaison. Warm dishes 11:30–21:00. Vegetarian & vegan options; take-away via app; family-friendly.

places.name: Café Restaurant Zalino
places.near: Via Staziun 25, at Zuoz RhB station; parking
places.order: Breakfast plate with local cheese and bread, home-made cake, coffee
places.notes: Source: pontresina.ch guide listing 'Bistro Zalino' (hours, coords)
places.famousFor: Cosy café-restaurant by Zuoz station serving a proper breakfast, home-made cakes and lunch – pairs with a Badilatti visit and the Zuoz old-town walk
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 08:00–20:00; SUNDAY CLOSED (not for 11 Oct – use Sat 10 or Mon 12). Season 29 Jun 2026–31 Mar 2027, so no Zwischensaison break. Terrace, WiFi.

places.name: Alpine gourmet breakfast – Hotel Belvédère Scuol
places.near: Stradun 330, main street of Scuol; bus 'Scuol, Belvédère'; hotel parking
places.order: Regional cheese board, Sent eggs, Birnenbrot, local honey; the Marenda afternoon-snack option
places.notes: Source: engadin.com brunch & breakfast page (price, hours, reservation) + belvedere-hotelfamilie.ch
places.famousFor: Lower-Engadin 'Schlemmer' breakfast buffet open to non-guests: bread from the village baker, meat and cheese from the region, eggs from Sent, home-made jams – in the 4*S Belvédère on the Stradun
places.goodToKnow: Daily 07:30–11:00 for external guests CHF 45 pp, ADVANCE RESERVATION REQUIRED (reservation@belvedere-scuol.ch / +41 81 861 06 20). Sunday open. Hotel runs autumn packages, so open in October. Pork products on the buffet – plenty of cheese/egg/bakery alternatives.

places.name: Sunday brunch – IN LAIN Hotel Cadonau
places.near: Crusch Plantaun 217, Brail – on the main road 5 min before Zernez; RhB stop 'Brail' 8 min walk; parking
places.order: Brunch buffet with table service: farm eggs, Engadin cheeses, smoked trout, pastries, smoothies; CHF 98 option adds Swiss National Park Centre entry
places.notes: Source: brunchselection.ch In Lain page (price, hours, inclusions) + engadin.com listing (coords, spring closure)
places.famousFor: Switzerland's smallest 5*S hotel, a farm-to-table Relais & Châteaux in Brail between Zuoz and Scuol; every Sunday a lavish brunch in La Stüvetta or on the sunny terrace
places.goodToKnow: SUNDAY ONLY 09:00–14:00 – fits Sun 11 Oct exactly. CHF 89 adults / CHF 35 children 4–12 / under-3 free; reservation required (hotel@inlain.ch, +41 81 851 20 00). Package lists a glass of champagne – simply decline; coffee/juices/smoothies à discrétion. Gluten/lactose needs handled with notice. Open year-round except a spring break (6 Apr–13 May 2026).

places.name: Breakfast buffet in the Cuort – Hotel Engiadina
places.near: Rablüzza 152, old village core of Scuol, 3 min from the Stradun; bus 'Scuol, Posta'
places.order: Fruit bread with mountain cheese, home-made jams, a boiled Sent egg; come back 14:30–16:30 for the cake buffet
places.notes: Source: hotel-engiadina.ch Cuort page (buffet contents) + engadin.com listing (coords, external guests welcome, cake buffet hours)
places.famousFor: Typical Engadin house in Scuol whose breakfast is built on its own products: home-made jams, apple juice from the hotel's trees, organic yoghurt and mountain cheese from Lataria Sent, organic Sent eggs, home-made fruit bread; afternoon cake buffet
places.goodToKnow: Breakfast buffet daily (hours not published – hotels here typically 07:30–10:30); external guests explicitly welcome in the restaurant – phone +41 81 864 14 21 the day before for a table and price. Afternoon cake buffet 14:30–16:30. Sunday open; no autumn closure announced. Organic, vegetarian-friendly.

places.name: Mountain breakfast at Muottas Muragl
places.near: Funicular from Punt Muragl (bus stop 'Punt Muragl Talstation' between Samedan and Pontresina); trains 07:45–23:00 every 30 min
places.order: Coffee and pastries at the Scatla/terrace from 08:00; hotel breakfast buffet if you book it as an outside guest
places.notes: Source: muottasmuragl.ch operating-hours + panorama-restaurant pages (hours, season) + engadin.ch listing (coords)
places.famousFor: Take the 07:45 first funicular and have coffee, croissants and the sunrise-lit lake panorama at 2,456 m; the Romantik Hotel's buffet is the classic Engadin 'breakfast with a view'
places.goodToKnow: Season 6 Jun–25 Oct 2026 – OPEN 10–12 Oct incl. Sunday; Panorama Restaurant 08:00–23:00, Scatla 08:00–17:00, terrace from 08:00. The breakfast buffet is part of hotel packages – day-visitor breakfast/price NOT published; call +41 81 842 82 32 to reserve. No dedicated autumn sunrise-train breakfast offer found for 2026 (sunrise rides are a summer product). Add funicular fare; cold at 08:00 in October.

places.name: Restaurant Stüva breakfast buffet – Hotel Laudinella
places.near: Via Tegiatscha 17, St. Moritz-Bad; bus 'St. Moritz Bad, Laudinella' or 'Ovaverva'
places.order: Bircher müesli, cheese and egg station, fresh breads; kids up to 12 eat free on Laudinella buffets
places.notes: Source: restaurant-stueva.ch (hours) + stmoritz.com Stüva listing (guest-only note) + laudinella.ch
places.famousFor: St. Moritz-Bad's biggest buffet breakfast (Swiss + international) in the Laudinella's Stüva, from 06:30 – the early-start option before a Bernina Express or Corvatsch day
places.goodToKnow: Breakfast daily 06:30–10:00 (summer) / 07:00–10:30 (winter); hotel open year-round incl. Sunday. FLAG: the stmoritz.com listing currently says breakfast is for hotel guests only – call +41 81 836 06 19 to ask for an outside-guest slot and price (older reference CHF 38 pp). Vegetarian-friendly; pork present on buffet.

places.name: Hotel Saratz breakfast & Pitschna Scena
places.near: Via da la Staziun 2, lower Pontresina next to the RhB station; parking
places.order: Buffet with Engadin breads and regional cheeses; later, Pitschna Scena lunch 12:00–14:30
places.notes: Source: saratz.ch (season dates, venue hours, address)
places.famousFor: Family-oriented 4* Saratz (Belle-Époque wing + modern wing, large park, kids' club) opposite Pontresina station; breakfast buffet plus the informal Pitschna Scena bistro later in the day
places.goodToKnow: Open continuously 21 May 2026–27 Mar 2027 – OPEN 10–12 Oct incl. Sunday (no Zwischensaison break). Breakfast for outside guests on request, price not published (+41 81 839 40 00). Pitschna Scena 12:00–14:30 & 18:00–23:00 open to all; very family-friendly.

places.name: GROND Engadin – Celerina (ex-Bäckerei Gredig)
places.near: Centre of Celerina at the roundabout, 2 min from any Celerina chalet on foot; parking by the roundabout
places.order: A small Nusstorte to keep in the chalet (keeps 2–3 weeks), a Birnbrot loaf for breakfast, butter croissants in the morning
places.notes: grond-engadin.ch + pontresina.ch guide (Furnaria Grond Celerina) + search.ch listings; Gredig/Grond share address and phone
places.famousFor: The chalet-village bakery: Engadiner Nusstorte, Bündner Birnbrot and 'Creation Grond' chocolate, all baked at 1,800 m by Furnaria Grond (S-chanf); the old Gredig shop at the Celerina roundabout now trades as Grond
places.goodToKnow: Summer season runs early June to mid-October, so 10–12 Oct is the last weekend; call +41 81 833 33 31 to confirm hours (Grond says 'ask directly'). Other branches: Pontresina (opposite Kronenhof, daily 07:00–12:00), Silvaplana (Via Traviers 3), Sils-Maria (Via da Marias 134, home of the original Silser Birnbrot since 1923), La Punt (Via Cumünela 17)

places.name: Gianottis Zuckerbäckerei & Piz Süss
places.near: Lower part of Via Maistra in Pontresina, near the Kronenhof; 8 min drive from Celerina
places.order: Single-origin chocolate bars and pralines, a Nusstorte, hot chocolate for the kids
places.notes: gianottis.ch (address, Instagram, phone) + myswitzerland.com/guidle listings for hours
places.famousFor: Pontresina's modern confiserie: handmade chocolate from single-origin cacao, Engadiner Nusstorte, Birnbrot and pastries, with the 'Wilderei' café-grill next door
places.goodToKnow: Summer hours were Mon–Sat 09:00–24:00, Sunday closed; season listed as running to about 20 Oct 2026 – confirm autumn hours on +41 81 842 70 90 before driving over

places.name: Hauser Confiserie & Café
places.near: Central St. Moritz Dorf next to the Schulhausplatz; park in Parkhaus Serletta or Quadrellas and walk up
places.order: Nusstorte slice + hot chocolate on the terrace; take-away box of Nusstorte and Birnbrot; ice-cream coupes for the children
places.notes: stmoritz.com directory + engadin.ch shopping listing + Instagram @hauserstmoritz
places.famousFor: The St. Moritz family confiserie (Hauser family since 1955) known for its own Engadiner Nusstorte, Bündner Birnbrot, truffles/pralines and 'legendary' butter and wholegrain croissants; big sunny terrace on the village square
places.goodToKnow: OPEN DAILY incl. Sunday, 07:30–23:00 (restaurant + confiserie) – reliable Sunday dessert stop in St. Moritz; hotel and confiserie are open year-round

places.name: Läderach chocolatier suisse – St. Moritz
places.near: Via Serlas, the shopping street beside Badrutt's Palace, 3 min walk from Parkhaus Serletta escalators
places.order: FrischSchoggi by weight (hazelnut, pistachio, strawberry), a box of pralines, kids pick their own mix
places.notes: stmoritz.com/pontresina.ch directory listings (address, hours, phone)
places.famousFor: The Läderach FrischSchoggi slabs broken to order, pralines and truffles; the only big-name Swiss chocolatier boutique in the Engadin, on the luxury shopping street
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Fri 09:00–19:00, Sat 09:00–18:00; closed Sunday – buy on Saturday 10 Oct. Tel +41 81 833 57 26

places.name: Gelateria Palace (Badrutt's Palace)
places.near: Via Serlas, next to Badrutt's Palace entrance, 3 min from Parkhaus Serletta
places.order: Two-scoop cone (pistachio + seasonal fruit sorbet) with toppings
places.notes: badruttspalace.com + search.ch listing; enjoy-ski.com for the 2026 summer season dates (25 Jun–7 Sep)
places.famousFor: St. Moritz's famous queue-worthy gelato window on Via Serlas – ice creams and fruit sorbets made daily by the Palace pastry team (Stefan Gerber), 30+ toppings
places.goodToKnow: SUMMER ONLY (daily 12:00–18:00 in season). Badrutt's Palace summer season ended 7 Sept 2026, so expect it CLOSED on 10–12 Oct – listed for reference; for gelato in October rely on Hauser (coupes) or hotel bars

places.name: Belvedere Alp Grüm – terrace café on the Bernina line
places.near: Drive to Bernina Diavolezza (free parking) or Pontresina station and take the RhB Bernina train to Alp Grüm (~25 min from Diavolezza); restaurant is beside the station platform
places.order: Cake or dessert of the day with hot chocolate on the terrace; the neighbouring Albergo Ristorante Alp Grüm lists 'Eisspezialitäten' (ice-cream specialities) and pizzoccheri if you want lunch
places.notes: belvedere-alpgruem.ch (season to 18 Oct 2026, Instagram) + alpgruem.ch menu headings + pontresina.ch guide
places.famousFor: Coffee-and-cake stop at 2,091 m with the Palü glacier straight ahead – reached only by the Bernina train (no road), the classic family half-day from Pontresina
places.goodToKnow: Belvedere open until 18 Oct 2026, so your dates are inside the season; both Alp Grüm restaurants are seasonal (approx. Apr–Oct). Tel +41 76 774 65 00. Kaiserschmarrn was not confirmed on the online menus – ask on the day · Location needs verification

places.name: Grand Hotel Kronenhof – Afternoon Tea in the Lobby
places.near: Lower Pontresina, hotel driveway off Via Maistra; hotel car park or street parking; 8 min from Celerina
places.order: Engadiner Afternoon Tea (from CHF 37 pp) – enough scones/cakes to share among children; hot chocolate instead of tea for the kids
places.notes: kronenhof.com bar & lobby page (hours) + Tripadvisor/Kronenhof (CHF 37 options) + kronenhof.com Saisondaten; Kulm dates from kulm.com via search
places.famousFor: Daily afternoon tea under the frescoed ceilings of the 1848 grand hotel: 'Engadiner' tea (Nusstorte, local pastries) or 'Kronenhof' tea, with live piano in the lobby
places.goodToKnow: Served daily 15:00–17:00, reservation preferred; Kronenhof runs summer, AUTUMN and winter seasons, so it is open in October (Pavillon restaurant runs to 24 Oct 2026). Kulm Hotel St. Moritz is closed until its winter opening on 4 Dec 2026 – no Kulm tea on your dates

places.name: Hotel Waldhaus Sils – coffee & cake in the Great Hall
places.near: Sils Maria, 25 min drive from Celerina via Silvaplana; hotel car park up the hill (short steep drive, fine for a van)
places.order: Coffee and the cake trolley selection (Engadin nut tart, fruit tarts) in the Great Lounge; hot chocolate for kids
places.notes: waldhaus-sils.ch (great lounge, newsletter 'Sommersaison noch bis 25. Oktober') + Tripadvisor mentions of afternoon tea
places.famousFor: Family-run 1908 grand hotel above Sils where afternoon coffee, house cakes and live music in the hall are a ritual – the Nietzsche/Sils atmosphere in one stop
places.goodToKnow: Summer season 2026 runs until 25 Oct, so open on your dates; afternoon music/tea is a summer-season offer – confirm the day's programme on arrival. Pair with the Furtschellas cable car or the Fex valley walk

places.name: Cafè Badilatti – Europe's highest coffee roastery & Caferama
places.near: Zuoz, 20 min drive from Celerina down the valley; easy parking on the edge of the village

places.famousFor: Same UNESCO route as the Bernina Express, hourly, no reservation, opening windows – hop off at Morteratsch, Diavolezza, Ospizio Bernina or Alp Grüm
places.goodToKnow: Buy on the SBB app; free with Swiss Travel Pass; kids under 6 free, Junior Card for 6–15 with a parent. Sit on the right side going south for Lago Bianco. Alp Grüm restaurant terrace looks straight at the Palü glacier · Kids: All ages; windows open for photos

places.name: Val Roseg Horse Omnibus
places.near: Departs 1 min from Pontresina station towards the village, next to the Valentin wine shop / Station Hotel; 7 km, ~1 h each way
places.notes: engadin-kutschen.ch Pferde-Omnibus page (Wohlis Kutschbetrieb)
places.famousFor: Scheduled horse-drawn omnibus up the car-free Val Roseg to Hotel Restaurant Roseg Gletscher under the Roseg glacier – a top golden-larch valley
places.goodToKnow: Summer timetable 12 June–18 October; departures Pontresina 10:10–15:10, returns 11:45–16:45. Adult CHF 25 one-way / 37 return, child 4–12 CHF 12.50 / 18.50. CASH ONLY (no cards) at the kiosk. Reserve +41 78 944 75 55 (08:00–17:30). Walk one way (flat gravel, stroller-OK) · Kids: Perfect for all; 4yo half price

places.name: Morteratsch Glacier Trail
places.near: Regional train to Morteratsch stop (12 km from St. Moritz) or car park at Hotel Morteratsch on the Bernina road
places.notes: swissfamilyfun.com Morteratsch walk + Wikipedia station coords
places.famousFor: Switzerland's easiest walk to a glacier: 2.9 km flat gravel path from Morteratsch station to the ice tongue, with year-markers showing how far the glacier has retreated since 1900
places.goodToKnow: Free, open year-round; 5.8 km round trip ~1.5–2 h; kids' task booklet with reward at Hotel Morteratsch; larch forest along the trail turns gold mid–late October. Alp cheese dairy at the trailhead closes 04.10.2026 · Kids: Stroller-OK; 4yo can walk it

places.name: Chastè Peninsula, Lake Sils
places.near: 20 min walk from Sils Maria post bus stop via Sils Baselgia; car park at Sils Baselgia
places.notes: sils.ch Chastè page + Wikipedia Lake Sils coords
places.famousFor: Wooded peninsula jutting into Lake Sils – Nietzsche's 'most beautiful place in the Engadin' – with his memorial stone at the tip and views to Maloja
places.goodToKnow: Free; easy loop trail ~1 h with benches; strong Maloja wind on the lake after midday, calm mornings for reflections; pair with Nietzsche-Haus in the village · Kids: All ages; 1 h loop, benches

places.name: Lake Silvaplana Kitesurf Spot
places.near: Lakeside at Silvaplana, kite/surf centres on the shore road; Engadin bus 'Silvaplana, Kreisel Mitte', 10 min from St. Moritz
places.notes: silvaplana.ch kitesurfing + kitesailing.ch spot guide
places.famousFor: One of Europe's top kite and wingfoil lakes: the thermal Maloja wind kicks in around noon and the lake fills with colourful kites against the mountains
places.goodToKnow: Main season end of May–early October; in October wind blows ~50% of days, from about 11:00–14:00 onward – go after lunch on a sunny day. Free to watch from the lakeside path; kitesailing.ch has a live wind forecast · Location needs verification · Kids: All ages to watch; no lessons for 4yo

places.name: Val Fex Horse Carriage (Sils)
places.near: Carriages wait on the village square in Sils Maria by the post bus stop
places.notes: sils.ch activity providers + coretti.ch
places.famousFor: Horse-drawn carriage from Sils village square up the car-free Fex valley to Crasta or Hotel Fex, past hamlets, larch meadows and the Fex glacier backdrop
places.goodToKnow: Two operators: Coretti +41 81 826 56 73 and Clalüna +41 81 826 52 86; return prices include a 2-hour stay, extra half hour CHF 50; book ahead. Alternative: free Hotel Fex minibus (4 rides/day) or walk 1.5 h. Lunch at Hotel Fex or Pensiun Crasta · Location needs verification · Kids: All ages; private carriage fits 7

places.name: Swiss National Park Centre Zernez
places.near: In Zernez next to the castle, 45 min by car from St. Moritz or RhB train to Zernez then 5 min walk
places.notes: nationalpark.ch visit page
places.famousFor: Hands-on visitor centre for Switzerland's only national park with exhibits on ibex, bearded vultures and the park's wild forests; starting point for kid trails
places.goodToKnow: Open daily 08:30–18:00 until 25.10.2026 (from 26.10 Mon–Sat 09:00–12:00/14:00–17:00). Buy the Champlönch children's trail booklet here; park itself is free, dogs banned, stay on paths · Kids: Interactive; great 4–15

places.name: Champlönch Children's Trail (Il Fuorn)
places.near: Post bus from Zernez to 'Ova Spin' (car park 1) or drive the Ofenpass road; return by post bus from Il Fuorn
places.notes: nationalpark.ch adventure trails + engadin.com Kinderpfad Champlönch
places.famousFor: Easy 3.5 km app-guided trail from Ova Spin car park 1 to Il Fuorn where animals 'appear' on the phone at 10 spots and tell stories – the park's signature kids' hike
places.goodToKnow: Download the Swiss National Park app and get the booklet at the Zernez centre; about 2–2.5 h; Hotel Parc Naziunal Il Fuorn at the end for lunch; October larches inside the park are spectacular · Location needs verification · Kids: Made for 6–12; 4yo needs carrying

places.name: Segantini Museum
places.near: On the road between St. Moritz Dorf and Bad, Engadin bus 'St. Moritz, Segantini Museum'
places.notes: segantini-museum.ch information page
places.famousFor: Domed 1908 museum built for Giovanni Segantini's Alpine triptych 'Life – Nature – Death', the Engadin's most famous paintings
places.goodToKnow: Open 20.05–20.10.2026 Tue–Sun 11:00–17:00, closed Monday; adult about CHF 15. 2026 exhibition 'The symbolism of water' until 20 Oct. Allow 45 min · Kids: Short visit; teens appreciate

places.name: Berry Museum
places.near: Villa Arona in St. Moritz Dorf, 5 min walk from Via Serlas
places.notes: stmoritz.com museums + berrymuseum.com
places.famousFor: Villa Arona collection of spa-doctor-painter Peter Robert Berry (1864–1942), Segantini's contemporary, with luminous Engadin landscapes
places.goodToKnow: Summer 2026 open 15.06–23.10.2026, daily 14:00–16:00; small, 30-min visit; guided tours on request +41 81 833 30 18 · Kids: Quick stop; adults and teens

places.name: Nietzsche-Haus Sils Maria
places.near: Centre of Sils Maria, 3 min from the post bus stop
places.notes: nietzschehaus.ch visitor information; coords Wikipedia
places.famousFor: The plain village house where Nietzsche spent seven summers and wrote parts of Zarathustra; his room kept as it was
places.goodToKnow: Open Tue–Sun 15:00–18:00 until 25.10.2026; adult CHF 10, students CHF 5, under 10 free; Wednesday intro lectures 10:30 until 21.10.2026. Combine with the Chastè walk · Kids: 17/15 only; under 10 free

places.name: Chesa Planta Samedan
places.near: Samedan village centre, 5 min from Samedan station
places.notes: cultura-engiadina.ch + myswitzerland.com Chesa Planta
places.famousFor: Grand 16th-century patrician Engadin house preserved with original panelled rooms, Romansh library and a Salis–Planta costume exhibition
places.goodToKnow: Open 17.06–17.10.2026 Tue–Sat 16:00–19:00 (closed Sun/Mon); adult CHF 15, under 16 free; guided tour Wednesdays 16:00; special exhibition 'Mercenaries, Diplomats and Bon Vivants' to 17 Oct · Kids: Under 16 free; 30-min look

places.name: Museum Engiadinais
places.near: Via dal Bagn between St. Moritz Dorf and Bad, next to the Segantini Museum bus stop
places.notes: stmoritz.com Museum Engiadinais page
places.famousFor: 1906 'Engadin house' museum with 20 furnished period rooms showing how wealthy Engadin families lived, from sgraffito to stone-pine parlours
places.goodToKnow: Summer 26.05–23.10.2026, Thu–Sun 11:00–17:00, closed Mon–Wed; combine with Segantini Museum across the road · Kids: Period rooms; fine for 9+

places.name: Mili Weber Haus
places.near: Above St. Moritz Bad near Lej Marsch, 10 min walk from the Signal cable car
places.notes: stmoritz.com Mili Weber Museum page
places.famousFor: Tiny painted house of illustrator Mili Weber, every wall covered with fairies, animals and flowers – a hidden gem visited by guided tour only
places.goodToKnow: Guided tours only: high season Wed–Sun 14:15 and 15:45, low season Wed/Fri 14:15 on request; adult CHF 20, child 5–16 CHF 5, minimum CHF 50 per tour; book +41 79 539 97 77 / info@miliweber.ch · Location needs verification · Kids: Fairy-tale house; kids 5–12 love

places.name: Zuoz Village & Sgraffito Houses
places.near: RhB train to Zuoz (25 min from St. Moritz) then 5 min uphill, or 20 min by car; park at the station
places.notes: engadin.ch Zuoz page + guided village tour page
places.famousFor: Best-preserved Engadin village: Plazza with the Crusch Alva inn, San Luzi church, Planta houses and tower, and streets of sgraffito-etched facades and oriel windows
places.goodToKnow: Free guided village tour every Tuesday in season (check engadin.ch 'Guided village tour Zuoz'); the main square is the photo spot at morning light; combine with Cafè Badilatti and the Volg for chalet supplies · Kids: Stroll for all; fountain square

places.name: Bogn Engiadina Scuol Mineral Baths
places.near: Scuol, 1 h 15 by car from St. Moritz via Zernez, or RhB train to Scuol-Tarasp then 10 min walk
places.notes: bognengiadina.ch opening hours + engadin.com Bogn Engiadina
places.famousFor: Alpine mineral-water spa with indoor and outdoor pools, whirlpools and rapids fed by Scuol's springs – the Engadin's best rainy-day family plan
places.goodToKnow: Open year-round; 2026: brine pool closed until mid-July, sauna area closed until early October (should be back for 10–12 Oct). Roman-Irish bath is nude and 18+; kids in sauna only Wed/Sun 10:30–16:30 with parents. Prices on bognengiadina.ch, +41 81 861 26 00 · Kids: Pools OK all ages; sauna 18+

places.name: Ovaverva Pool & Spa St. Moritz
places.near: St. Moritz Bad next to the Signal cable car, Engadin bus 'St. Moritz Bad, Signalbahn'
places.notes: ovaverva.ch opening hours + news
places.famousFor: St. Moritz's modern indoor pool with 4 pools, 3 water slides, outdoor pool and a 1,620 m² spa – fully refurbished and reopened May 2026
places.goodToKnow: Pool & spa daily 10:00–21:00 (Tue from 08:00), last entry 1 h before closing; maintenance closure 16–29.11.2026 (after your dates). Earlier list price adult CHF 16, child CHF 8 – check 2026 tariff on site. +41 81 836 61 00 · Kids: 3 slides; kids' pool for the 4yo

places.name: Bellavita Pool & Spa Pontresina
places.near: Pontresina village centre, Engadin bus 'Pontresina, Rondo'
places.notes: bellavita-pontresina.ch opening hours
places.famousFor: Pontresina's family adventure pool: 75 m 'black hole' slide with light effects, 25 m pool with diving board and a water play garden for small kids
places.goodToKnow: Open 08.06.2026–23.05.2027; Mon/Tue/Fri/Sat 10:00–21:00, Wed 06:00–21:00, Thu 08:00–21:00; adult entry about CHF 12; cheaper and calmer than Ovaverva · Kids: 75 m black-hole slide; play garden

places.name: Tarasp Castle (Chastè da Tarasp)
places.near: Above Tarasp village, 10 min by car from Scuol, or post bus 'Tarasp, Fontana' then 10 min uphill walk
places.notes: engadin.com guided tour Tarasp Castle; coords Wikipedia
places.famousFor: 1,000-year-old hilltop castle above Scuol owned by artist Not Vital, mixing knights' halls and a giant organ with contemporary art
places.goodToKnow: Guided tours only, 02.06–01.11.2026; adult CHF 13 with guest card (15 without), child 7–15 CHF 8; register at notvital.com/fundaziun, meet at the courtyard ticket office; +41 81 557 17 66 · Kids: Tour ~1 h; 9+ enjoy, 4yo restless

places.name: Olympia Bob Run St. Moritz–Celerina
places.near: Start above St. Moritz Bad at the Kulm Park end, finish in Celerina
places.notes: olympia-bobrun.ch + myswitzerland.com guest bob ride
places.famousFor: World's oldest and only natural-ice bobsleigh run (1904); guest rides in a 4-man bob at up to 135 km/h – but it is a WINTER attraction
places.goodToKnow: NOT operating in October: 2026/27 season opens 22.12.2026 (runs to early March). Guest ride CHF 269 pp incl. helmet, shuttle and diploma; book online. In October you can only see the empty track and Kulm Park · Kids: Winter only; guest ride 16+ adults

places.name: Stalla Engiadina Carriage Rides
places.near: Departures from Pontresina station or your hotel by arrangement
places.notes: stalla-engiadina.ch + stmoritz.com carriage rides
places.famousFor: Private horse-drawn carriages from Pontresina, St. Moritz or Celerina to Lej da Staz, Val Roseg or through the stone-pine forest – a golden-larch alternative to the public omnibus
places.goodToKnow: Open all year, one-way or round trips; prices on request (PDF on their site) – book reservation@stalla-engiadina.ch or +41 81 842 60 57. Also Coachman Giovanoli +41 79 634 30 74 in St. Moritz · Kids: Private carriage; all 5 kids fit
places.address: Via Pros da God Sur 27, 7504 Pontresina

places.name: E-Bike Rental – Skiservice Corvatsch / Engadin Bike
places.near: Skiservice Corvatsch shops in St. Moritz Dorf and Silvaplana; Engadin Bike in St. Moritz; Fähndrich Sport in Pontresina
places.notes: skiservice-corvatsch.com rent-a-bike + engadin.ch e-bike page
places.famousFor: Flat lakeside e-bike loops St. Moritz–Silvaplana–Sils and the Pontresina–Val Roseg gravel road are ideal family rides; several shops rent kids' bikes and e-MTBs
places.goodToKnow: Swiss law: e-bike riders 14+ (16+ without licence); kids' bicycles, trailers and child seats available; guided e-bike tours 2–4 h bookable; the lake path Silvaplana–Sils is paved and flat. Segway tours are not offered locally · Kids: Kids' bikes + child seats; 12+ e-bike

places.name: Golden Larches & the Larch Tracker
places.near: Best golden spots: Val Roseg, Morteratsch, Stazerwald/Lej da Staz, Val Fex, Muottas Muragl panorama trail, National Park Ofenpass road
places.notes: graubuenden.ch Larch Tracker + swissfamilyfun.com golden larches
places.famousFor: The Engadin's larch forests turn gold after the first frosts – Graubünden's online 'Larch Tracker' shows the live colour status so you pick the right valley
places.goodToKnow: Larches usually start turning mid-October and peak in the 3rd–4th week; 10–12 Oct 2026 is early-to-mid season – lower valleys (Staz, Roseg) may be greener, higher slopes (Muottas Muragl, Diavolezza side) more advanced. Check the tracker the week before · Kids: All ages; check before choosing hikes

places.name: Maloja Belvedere Tower
places.near: End of the Engadin at Maloja, 30 min by car or post bus from St. Moritz; short walk from Hotel Schweizerhaus past Segantini's round atelier
places.notes: bregaglia.ch Torre Belvedere + Segantini atelier page
places.famousFor: Castle-style 1880s tower of Count de Renesse whose roof terrace looks down the Bregaglia gorge and back over the Engadin lakes; glacier potholes in the grounds
places.goodToKnow: Open daily in summer 10:00–17:00 with changing exhibitions – confirm October dates with Bregaglia tourism; the neighbouring Segantini atelier only opens Sat/Sun 16:00–18:00 in season. Great sunset spot over Lake Sils · Kids: Tower steps; all ages, hold 4yo

places.name: Cafè Badilatti Caferama
places.near: Lower Zuoz near the station
places.notes: cultura-engiadina.ch Caferama + tripadvisor
places.famousFor: Europe's highest coffee roastery (since 1912) with the small Caferama coffee museum and a shop selling Engadin-roasted beans
places.goodToKnow: Museum/shop open Mon–Fri 14:00–17:00 from 29.06 to 23.10.2026, closed weekends – plan a weekday; guided roastery tour ~1 h with tasting on request +41 81 854 27 27 · Kids: Roastery smell; fine for all

places.name: Via Serlas Luxury Row
places.near: St. Moritz Dorf between Badrutt's Palace and the Kempinski shopping arcade; 5 min uphill from the station
places.notes: crystalhotel.ch Via Serlas guide + bulgari.com store locator
places.famousFor: 'Highest luxury shopping street in the world' below Badrutt's Palace: Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Prada, Dior, Cartier, Bulgari, Hermès, Bottega Veneta, Miu Miu, Zegna, Fusalp
places.goodToKnow: Many boutiques run seasonal hours – some close between the summer and winter seasons (late Oct–early Dec); early-mid October most are still open but check the individual store. Bulgari is temporarily in Badrutt's Palace during renovation · Kids: Window-shopping; not for 4yo

places.name: Trois Pommes The Store
places.near: St. Moritz Dorf near Via Serlas
places.notes: crystalhotel.ch Via Serlas shopping guide
places.famousFor: Swiss multi-brand luxury boutique (Zurich-based) with an edited mix of international designer labels – the best one-stop fashion shop in St. Moritz
places.goodToKnow: Seasonal opening – confirm October hours; part of the Via Serlas/Palace shopping circuit · Kids: Teens' designer wishlist

places.name: Hatecke Butchery & Bistro
places.near: Via Maistra in St. Moritz Dorf, 2 min from Hanselmann
places.notes: guide.michelin.com Hatecke + myswitzerland.com
places.famousFor: Design-led Engadin butcher (family craft since the 1700s) famed for Salsiz, Bündnerfleisch and dried venison in minimalist packaging; Michelin-listed bistro next door
places.goodToKnow: Products are beef, venison and pork mixes – ask staff about pure-beef/venison items; gift boxes travel well. Also shops in Scuol and Zuoz. +41 81 833 12 77 · Kids: Sandwiches for all; halal-free note

places.name: Furnaria Grond Pontresina (Nusstorte)
places.near: Old village centre of Pontresina, across from Hotel Kronenhof; other shops in Sils Maria, Silvaplana and La Punt
places.notes: grond-engadin.ch + pontresina.ch Flaniermeile story
places.famousFor: Local bakery chain (since 2004) known for its hexagonal Engadiner Nusstorte in gift packaging; Pontresina shop sits opposite the Grand Hotel Kronenhof
places.goodToKnow: Nusstorte keeps 3–4 weeks – ideal to carry home; also fresh bread, Birnbrot and coffee to go; morning opening · Kids: Cake for everyone

places.name: Gianottis Piz Süss Confectionery
places.near: Via Maistra, Pontresina village centre
places.notes: gianottis.ch Zuckerbäckerei page
places.famousFor: 125-year-old Pontresina confectioner whose Nusstorte and Birnbrot follow an ancestor's recipe book – the connoisseur's pick over the chains
places.goodToKnow: Café attached for a coffee stop after the Val Roseg omnibus; Nusstorte sold in several sizes and ships worldwide · Kids: Pastries + chocolate; all ages

places.name: Zisler Spezialitäten Samedan
places.near: Samedan, near the station/airport road
places.notes: nusstorten.ch
places.famousFor: Small Samedan specialty bakery devoted to Engadiner Nusstorte and Birnbrot (nusstorten.ch) – a local, non-touristy source
places.goodToKnow: Run by Renato Longa; call ahead for larger orders; combine with Chesa Planta and Butia Tradiziun in Samedan · Kids: Grab-and-go; all ages

places.name: Butia Tradiziun Samedan
places.near: Samedan village centre
places.notes: tradiziun.ch
places.famousFor: Home boutique of handcrafted Engadin gifts – Swiss stone-pine (Arve) objects, textiles, ceramics and local design – the best one-stop souvenir shop in the Upper Engadin
places.goodToKnow: Arve (stone-pine) pillows and boards are the signature Engadin gift; online shop for anything you can't carry · Kids: Wooden toys, stone-pine gifts

places.name: La Butietta Scuol (Kids' Shop)
places.near: Stradun, Scuol main street; also Engadina Gourmet deli and Stöckenius toy shop nearby
places.notes: engadin.com La Butietta + shops Lower Engadin
places.famousFor: Baby and children's boutique on Scuol's Stradun with wooden toys, Lego Wear and Alpine kids' fashion
places.goodToKnow: Pair with Bogn Engiadina on a Scuol day; Stradun has the Dorf-Center for supplies · Kids: Made for the 4yo and 9yo

places.name: Butia da Besch Ardez (Sheep-Wool Crafts)
places.near: Ardez village, 15 min from Scuol on the way from Zernez; RhB stop Ardez
places.notes: engadin.com Butia da Besch Ardez
places.famousFor: Tiny cooperative shop in sgraffito-village Ardez where twelve Lower Engadin women knit, felt and weave products from local sheep's wool
places.goodToKnow: Limited opening hours – check engadin.com before driving; Ardez itself is a photogenic sgraffito village worth 30 min · Kids: Felt animals; kids 4–12

places.name: Coop St. Moritz Bellevue
places.near: Via dal Bagn, Engadin bus 'St. Moritz, Bellevue'; parking garage
places.notes: coop.ch store detail + pontresina.ch shopping guide
places.famousFor: Largest supermarket in St. Moritz for a chalet stay – full grocery, bakery, pharmacy corner – on the road between Dorf and Bad
places.goodToKnow: Second smaller Coop in St. Moritz Dorf at Plazza da Scuola 12; check coop.ch for hours – Swiss supermarkets close early evening and most are shut Sundays · Kids: Snacks and nappies run

places.name: Volg Pontresina & Volg Zuoz
places.near: Volg Pontresina at Via da Mulin 17 (village centre); Volg Zuoz at Pro Bosio near the station
places.notes: pontresina.ch Volg Zuoz + stmoritz.com Coop Pontresina pages
places.famousFor: Village convenience supermarkets with regional Engadin products (Nusstorte, cheese, local milk) – handy for chalets in Pontresina or the Zuoz side
places.goodToKnow: Smaller and pricier than Coop but open longer in villages; Sunday hours vary – check volg.ch · Kids: Village store basics

places.name: Muottas Muragl Panorama Viewpoint
places.near: Top station of the Muottas Muragl funicular, 2 min walk to the terrace and benches; sunset and blue hour are best
places.notes: muottasmuragl.ch + engadin.ch autumn bucket list
places.famousFor: The Engadin's signature postcard: lakes of St. Moritz, Champfèr, Silvaplana and Sils strung down the valley toward Maloja, framed by golden larches in October
places.goodToKnow: Funicular runs until 23:00 in season (to 25.10.2026) so you can shoot sunset/stars and still ride down; Philosophers' path and a short lake loop start here; bring layers, it's 2,456 m · Kids: All ages; flat terrace, fenced

places.name: Alp Grüm Station Terrace
places.near: Regional train or Bernina Express from St. Moritz (~1 h); 20-min photo stop on the Bernina Express
places.notes: Wikipedia Alp Grüm railway station (coords) + myswitzerland.com
places.famousFor: Restaurant terrace at 2,091 m directly opposite the Palü glacier with Lago Palü and the Poschiavo valley dropping away below – reachable only by train
places.goodToKnow: Ristorante Alp Grüm and small hotel on site; 90-min downhill walk from Ospizio Bernina ends here; check last train back (hourly) before lingering · Kids: All ages; step off the train

places.name: Lago Bianco & Ospizio Bernina
places.near: Train to Ospizio Bernina (~50 min from St. Moritz) or Bernina pass road, parking at the pass
places.notes: Wikipedia Lago Bianco + Ospizio Bernina station (coords), outdooractive route
places.famousFor: Milky turquoise reservoir at the 2,253 m pass summit, the highest point of the Bernina line; train tracks run along the shore for the classic red-train-and-lake shot
places.goodToKnow: Easy 5.5 km / 90 min walk Ospizio Bernina – Sassal Mason – Alp Grüm (mostly flat then descending, 286 m down); wind and snow possible in October, dress warm. Pass road stays open in October · Kids: All ages; flat lakeside path

places.name: Lej da Staz (Stazersee)
places.near: 30–40 min flat walk from St. Moritz Bad (start at the Catholic church) or from St. Moritz station; also from Celerina or Pontresina; carriage rides available
places.notes: Wikipedia Lej da Staz (coords) + swissfamilyfun.com
places.famousFor: Small forest lake in the Stazerwald whose still water mirrors golden larches in October – the Engadin's most Instagrammed autumn reflection
places.goodToKnow: Go on a calm, sunny morning for the reflection; Hotel Restaurant Lej da Staz on the shore, picnic spots, playground; wide gravel path, stroller-friendly; no car access · Kids: All ages; playground + flat path

places.name: Val Fex Valley
places.near: From Sils Maria on foot (1.5 h to Hotel Fex), by carriage, or the hotel shuttle; no private cars
places.notes: myswitzerland.com Val Fex + sils.ch
places.famousFor: Wide, car-free high valley with the tiny Fex-Crasta chapel, Romansh farmhouses and a wall of golden larches under the Fex glacier
places.goodToKnow: Best light mid-morning up-valley; larches peak mid–late October; chapel at Fex-Crasta is a classic frame; Hotel Fex terrace for lunch (check October opening) · Kids: All ages; stroller-OK dirt road

places.name: Prayer: no mosque in the Engadin – nearest is Moschee Chur
places.near: Chur is ~2 h / 120 km from Celerina via the Julier Pass and A13 (or Vereina car train + Prättigau); only realistic if you are passing Chur on the way in/out
places.notes: moschee-chur.ch contact page + sigzentrum.ch + relinfo.ch (Dzemat Chur); absence of Engadin mosques from Wikipedia 'Liste von Moscheen in der Schweiz' + engadin.ch searches
places.famousFor: There is NO mosque or prayer room anywhere in the Upper or Lower Engadin (St. Moritz–Scuol). The nearest are in Chur, the cantonal capital: Moschee Chur (Albanian Islamic cultural association, Kasernenstrasse 1), SIG Chur (Winterbergweg 2A) and the Bosnian Dzemat on Kasernenstrasse. Plan to pray in the chalet / car / on the mountain
places.goodToKnow: Qibla from the Engadin is roughly ESE (~125°); use Muslim Pro / Athan or the iPhone Compass. Jumu'ah is not an issue for these dates (Sat–Mon). Prayer times: moschee-chur.ch/gebetszeiten; email info@moschee-chur.ch. Bring a travel prayer mat – chalet floors are wood · Location needs verification
places.address: Moschee Chur, Kasernenstrasse 1, 7000 Chur (also SIG Chur, Winterbergweg 2A, 7000 Chur)

places.name: Coop Supermarkt Pontresina
places.near: Via da Mulin 17, lower Pontresina by the Rondo car park; free short-term customer parking
places.notes: coop.ch store page + profital.ch/openhours.ch listings (Sat 08–18, Sun closed)
places.famousFor: Nearest full-size supermarket to the Celerina chalet (8 min): fresh produce, fish counter, bakery, baby goods, and Coop's vegetarian/halal-friendly ranges (labelled 'halal' chicken is stocked by some Coop stores, not guaranteed here)
places.goodToKnow: Saturday 10 Oct 08:00–18:00; SUNDAY 11 Oct CLOSED (all Coop/Volg/Migros in the valley close Sundays) – do the big shop Saturday. Weekdays roughly 08:00–18:30. Tel +41 81 838 80 10

places.name: Coop St. Moritz Bellevue (Bad) + Coop St. Moritz Dorf

places.famousFor: Both passes are kept open all year, but mid-October can bring the first snow: check the live status before each drive. Julier (2,284 m) = your road from Chur/Zurich; Ofenpass (2,149 m) = the road Zernez → Val Müstair/Italy; Bernina (2,328 m) = to Diavolezza/Poschiavo
places.goodToKnow: Status as of 16 Sep 2026: Julier open, no restrictions; Ofenpass open. No dedicated snow-chain hire was found in the Engadin (garages such as Auto Mathis St. Moritz/Samedan sell them; Hertz Samedan at Cho d'Punt 34 adds chains to rentals).
